title: Network operator readiness upgrades
summary: Redesigned the Network Workers tab into a scan-first command board with health, attention, topology, readiness, role-aware quick actions, and selected-worker inspector evidence while keeping lifecycle/setup calls backend-owned.
reason: The previous Network Workers surface exposed too much text and repeated lifecycle/evidence content without enough quick operator controls or scan-ready worker health signals.
behavior_before: Network worker evidence was mostly long prose, lower preformatted detail, and broad lifecycle controls; attention priorities were not surfaced as compact worker-board evidence.
behavior_after: Network worker evidence renders as a compact command board with role-aware quick actions, diagnostic/readiness chips, compact attention items derived from existing worker evidence, topology nodes, worker view presets, and a right-side inspector fed by the existing read-only /api/network/workers payload.
manual_validation: Captured desktop/mobile Network command-board screenshots under LocalBase/validation/screenshots/MP-CHANGE-2026-0624-016 - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the Network WebView markup/CSS/JS changes, restore the previous browser/static test expectations, and restore the prior DOM inventory count.
notes:
